feedback: Dinis, 15 Oct 2026: publish three or four business models without naming the people who inspired them, as a full business plan, structure and architecture for somebody to copy (anybody who implements it implements sgit and ABPs). A Wardley map per service. A shopping cart with no payment: the order is emailed to agent@riskmandate.ai. Pages for independent consultants (white label or custom), companies adding this to their offering, and internal teams providing it internally. Every contact goes to agent@riskmandate.ai.
